title: AI-Powered Application Modernization using Claude-Flow | Derek Ashmore, Asperitas Consulting
description:
This is a teaser for Derek Ashmore’s full workshop at AI Native DevCon Fall, November 18–19.

What happens when you put a team of Claude-Code agents to work on modernizing legacy software? In this hands-on session, Derek Ashmore (Agentic AI Enablement Principal, Asperitas Consulting) demonstrates how to use Claude-Flow to perform a full 12-factor assessment of an open-source codebase — identifying what’s needed to make it truly cloud-native.

You’ll see how AI agents can help surface architectural issues, plan migration paths, and accelerate modernization projects — all while maintaining quality and control.

In the full DevCon workshop, you’ll learn:
- How to use Claude-Flow/Claude-Code to assess legacy codebases
- How agentic engineering practices can plan large-scale code migrations
- Common cloud-native issues uncovered in real modernization efforts
- Practical tactics for planning and executing cloud migrations

If you’re working with legacy systems and want to see how agentic workflows can transform modernization, this session is for you.

About the speaker:
Derek Ashmore is the Agentic AI Enablement Principal at Asperitas Consulting, where he helps enterprises leverage AI to modernize and migrate applications in the cloud. A longtime expert in DevSecOps, Azure, and AWS, he’s the author of Mastering the Shift: Collaborating with Teams of AI Coding Agents and a frequent speaker at events including Agile + DevOps East and DevOpsDays.
